outcome_detail: Modal sandbox timed out at 7200s before verifier could run. Agent was actively working (228 episodes, $28.60 cost) with a rendered output achieving ~3.21 mean pixel diff. The sandbox_timeout_secs config did not budget for env_setup + agent_setup overhead (~26s).
strategy: Frame extraction, pixel analysis, iterative Revideo scene refinement
agent_behavior: Extracted all 481 frames from reference.mp4 at 24fps and performed systematic pixel-level analysis using Python/NumPy/scipy to identify 12 colored squares in a 4x3 grid with pulse animations.
Correctly identified background color (#17182b), all 12 shape colors, grid positions, and the 3-phase animation pattern (row 1 pulse, row 2 pulse, row 3 static).
Built Revideo scene iteratively: started with basic circles, discovered shapes morph from circles to rounded rectangles during pulse, refined corner radius transitions.
Used systematic render-compare loop: render output, extract frames, compute per-frame mean absolute pixel difference against reference, identify worst frames, tune parameters.
Discovered asymmetric shape bulging (edge shapes bulge toward row center) and implemented position-shift correction.
Performed 228 episodes of fine-tuning over 2 hours, progressively reducing FULL AVG from ~8+ to 3.21.
No cheating attempts detected — purely algorithmic reverse-engineering approach with no access to /tests/, /logs/verifier/, or reward files.
Agent was still actively optimizing (testing wExpandWing values) when the sandbox timed out.
issues: sandbox_timeout_secs (7200) must exceed agent_timeout_sec (7200) + env_setup + agent_setup + verifier_timeout to guarantee verifier execution; currently they are equal
Agent's legitimate 2-hour effort and working output were wasted because the sandbox died before verification
Artifact collection also failed because the container was already gone — no /app/ artifacts were recovered
